bbmp_tss: csrc/retro/tss_engine.cpp and LICENSE.tss from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp, commit 19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged
(BSD-3-Clause, SPDX line in the file; a port of Takashi Toyoshima's T'SoundSystem, copyright (c) 2014, licence text in LICENSE.tss). T'SoundSystem
music is MML text (.tss) that the engine compiles, or compiled sequence data (.tsd).
engine.h is Selecta's own BSD-3-Clause stand-in for bbmp's GPL engine.h (the few names the engine uses). btss_glue.cpp is Selecta's glue: the
registry hook, to_utf8 (valid UTF-8 kept, else Latin-1; no Shift-JIS table, so a Shift-JIS title shows as Latin-1) and a C entry point that
renders the song. No GPL file is vendored: the module is core (not behind SELECTA_GPL_PLUGINS). Host only (C++17 engine; Amiga follow-up I710afa).
